principle: GameViewModel/coordinator owns state; a single presentation clock acknowledges presentationId; decorative animation completions never choose moves, draw pieces, advance turns, or unlock input.

tokenConstants.revealMillisUsage: Declared but unused by current production animation; it is not the 650ms reveal presentation hold.

animations.owner: HomeWordmark local Animatable values; app-shell saveable consumed flag
animations.trigger: first Home composition in a fresh saved session after persisted settings load

spring.note: Deterministic bounded keyframes, not an unbounded physics spring.

animations.layoutImpact: none; transforms are graphics layers on fixed measured text
animations.consumption: recorded as soon as entrance starts, not when it finishes; child latches entry request so parent recomposition does not abort current animation
animations.settingsWait: No animation begins before stored settings are known. App functional settings keep existing defaults during IO.
animations.navigation: return Home static after consumed; theme changes and recomposition static after settled
animations.recreation: restore consumed flag; even an interrupted entrance returns in final state
animations.reducedMotion: p=1 immediately; consumes any requested entrance once preferences are known; toggling on in flight cancels/snap-to-final; toggling off does not restart
animations.accessibility: one static full heading label, no spoken progress

animations.caveat: AnimatedContent's default size-transform machinery is not app-parametrized. Current screen children fill viewport, so no intentional navigation resize effect is specified.

animations.reducedMotion: duration0, translation0; immediate contact shade remains

animations.trigger: existing well changes symbol from null to placed; initially composed occupied well starts at final target

animations.purpose: required readable state; no decorative transition

animations.appParameters: none beyond semantic colors and checked state
animations.reducedMotion: No application-specific Switch animation override exists; rely on platform behavior and verify.
animations.ios: Use native Toggle; preserve single accessible row/target and explicit user setting; do not invent app-controlled Android timing.

animations.reducedMotion: identical static material presentation with different reveal hold

animations.purpose: illustrate that the bag can supply either X or O; the sole approved repeating Home illustration
animations.owner: FormHomeScene local visual state; independent of game/session/presentation state
animations.renderer: Two production FormPiece composables, progress=1, overlaid in the same fixed 44dp centered box; existing x/o face, highlight and edge semantic colors
animations.timingBasis: Nominal animation milliseconds at Android system animator scale1; nonzero platform duration scales are honored. Scale0 uses the explicit1400ms instant-swap fallback.
animations.repeat: while Home illustration is composed, visible, lifecycle RESUMED and stored settings are loaded

reducedMotion.note: Keep X/O alternation for comprehension; opacity is the only animated property.

systemAnimatorScaleZero.behavior: Instant X/O swaps on a gated delay; do not lose alternation when platform animations are disabled.

animations.layoutImpact: none; bag, arrows, board, scene dimensions, piece allocation and surrounding controls remain stationary; no translation or rotation
animations.lifecycle: Stop when inactive, not RESUMED, fully scrolled offscreen or removed from composition; restart locally from X when eligible again; do not persist illustration progress.

accessibility.contentDescription: A random X or O is drawn from the bag, then placed on the board.

animations.feedback: No sound or haptic events; tactile describes the visual pulse only.
animations.stateIndependence: Deterministic X/O alternation, not a random draw; no RNG calls, bag mutation, AI work, navigation change, saved-state change or game-stage acknowledgement.

stageDelays.semanticPurpose: read held symbol/actor before placement or AI targeting
identify selected coordinate while input locked
committed move appears, actor remains Computer
stable computer-move evidence before next turn or result

untimedExplanations.AI_THINKING: AI result arrival, no invented minimum think time

computerTurnStartThroughSettlementMs.note: assuming AI completes before reveal hold ends; excludes subsequent human TURN_START/reveal

presentationClock.aiComputation: starts immediately at successful computer reveal in background; early result waits reveal acknowledgement; late result enters AI_THINKING until completion; no animation-completion trigger
presentationClock.recreation: recreated composition starts full hold for current stage; elapsed milliseconds are not persisted; never re-draw or re-commit a placed move
presentationClock.reducedPreferenceChange: effect restarts with full duration for same current stage; IDs/guards still apply
presentationClock.staleCallbackGuard: screen==GAME and current presentationId must match; see state-machine.json for further revision/turn-token/target guards
presentationClock.terminalComputerMove: must pass AI_PLACING and AI_SETTLING with board/target/symbol evidence intact before TERMINAL opens
presentationClock.platformPort: Use one cancelable task keyed to stable presentation identity and stage; hold it independently of view animation. On iOS backgrounding, explicitly suspend/restart presentation acknowledgements so unread stages are not silently consumed.

feedback.owner: GameViewModel emits UiEffect by incrementing effectId; PicPacApp FeedbackEffects observes effectId
feedback.independence: Sound and haptics each respect their own persisted toggle. Reduced Motion does not mute feedback.

events.iosIntent: light selection-like contact and one quiet short reveal cue
light physical contact and one short placement cue
slightly more emphatic success event, never repeated/confetti-like
neutral end-of-game acknowledgement; do not present a game draw as an error

sound.exactWaveform: platform generated; no app-specified waveform, frequency envelope, or portable audio file

haptics.note: Semantic Android feedback types, not app-authored intensity values; physical tuning is not verified by emulator.

feedback.terminalTiming: WIN/DRAW emits when board move is committed; for computer it may precede result dialog during AI_PLACING. Do not replay when result opens.
feedback.lifecycleCaveat: A retained ViewModel still holds last effect/effectId; a new FeedbackEffects composition may replay it after Activity recreation. Effects are not included in process-restored GameUiState. No exactly-once across UI recreation guarantee is implemented; iOS should use consumable ephemeral effects, not reproduce accidental replay.
iosGuidance: Use platform haptic generators/native sensory feedback available at the chosen deployment target; do not copy Android enum names.
Honor silent mode, system sound expectations and separate app sound/haptic settings.
Choose one short native/synthesized cue per effect; no audio assets are promised by Android.
Do not generate title, AI-target, focus or bag-count feedback; those have no Android event.

iosImplementation.geometry: Render fixed layout, draw pieces/board as native paths, animate layer-like visual properties only.
iosImplementation.identity: Keep full heading accessibility label while visual pieces are separate; preserve internal English order in RTL.
iosImplementation.wordmark: Drive a shared elapsed-time value or finite keyframe sequence; use the exact cubic timing curves. Native opacity/offset/scale/rotation are sufficient. Do not use a repeating timer or spring with unknown completion.
iosImplementation.reduceMotion: Use in-app setting and native accessibility Reduce Motion to remove decorative transforms; the approved Home symbol illustration retains a slow opacity-only alternation (or instant swaps with animations disabled). Keep shortened essential stage holds readable.
iosImplementation.homeIllustration: Use a visibility/active-scene-scoped timeline or cancelable task for the prescribed X/O alternation. Render both native production pieces in one fixed box; retain the single stable description, no repeated VoiceOver announcements, no RNG or game-state connection. Cancel when offscreen/inactive and restart from X.
iosImplementation.state: Main-actor presentation coordinator accepts guarded transitions; worker actor/task searches immutable observation; cancels safely.
iosImplementation.testing: Inject presentation clock and AI completion, assert stage order/timers independent of animation; compare intermediate/final visual snapshots.
